Name: Mayonnaise Makeover
Author: omena007
Description:
Some of you may know me as the one who opposes pigeon mayonnaise but today I come to you with gifts: new mayonnaise sprites! I always thought the mayonnaise maker doesn't look too much like it makes mayonnaise so here we are.There's also an extra file for people who use 6480's[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266?tab=description] Blue and Golden Mayo[/url]﻿.


The mayo machine was inspired by Bflat's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5287]Korea Retro[/url] sprite machine sprite.
